sections.title: Application and Service Provider
paragraphs: These terms and conditions apply to the SwiftTransfer app for mobile devices, together with any related services operated by Caroline (collectively, the "Application"). Caroline is hereby referred to as the "Service Provider".
By downloading or using the Application, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. You should read them carefully before using the Application.

SwiftTransfer helps you transfer selected content between compatible iPhone and Android devices over a local network or using an external drive, import supported files, follow transfer guides and ask an AI assistant for help. Feature availability depends on the device, permissions, connection, file format and subscription status. The Application does not currently provide a public content feed, public profiles or user-to-user social messaging.

sections.title: Transfers, Permissions and Your Content
paragraphs: Transfer or import only content you own or are authorized to access and share. You are responsible for choosing the correct devices, recipient, files and transfer method, granting only the permissions you intend to grant, and checking the imported result. Keep an independent backup of important data. SwiftTransfer is not a backup service and does not guarantee that every device, file, metadata field or third-party app format will be supported or preserved.

Use local transfers on networks you trust. A pairing code, local address or session link may give another device access to a transfer session; share it only with the intended recipient and approve connections carefully. Do not expose a transfer session to an untrusted network. External-drive transfers depend on access to the drive and the operating system's file permissions. The browser-based local transfer uses HTTP rather than encrypted HTTPS/TLS; pairing and approval do not replace transport encryption.

Some operations read or create photos, contacts, calendar events or reminders after you give the relevant permission. Importing or saving data may create copies. Removing the Application does not necessarily remove content already saved in Photos, Contacts, Calendar, Reminders, Files, on another device or on an external drive.

sections.title: AI Assistant and Transfer Guides
paragraphs: The AI assistant and transfer guides provide general assistance, not a guarantee of a successful transfer or professional advice. AI-generated answers may be inaccurate, incomplete or outdated. Verify suggested steps, especially before deleting data, changing permissions or modifying another device.

Using the AI assistant sends your message and relevant conversation history to the AI service used by the Application. If Send technical context is enabled, technical details described in Settings and the Privacy Policy are also included. AI requests require an internet connection. Do not submit sensitive information or another person's data without the necessary permission or legal basis.
The assistant may suggest actions available in the Application. You remain responsible for reviewing and confirming actions and for maintaining your own backups.

sections.title: Device Security, Connectivity and Availability
paragraphs: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your device and access to the Application. The Service Provider strongly advises against jailbreaking or rooting your device, which may compromise security and prevent the Application from working correctly.

Local-network transfers require a working compatible local connection; AI requests and purchase services require internet access. The Service Provider cannot guarantee full functionality without the necessary network access, permissions, supported devices or available services. Your mobile provider's data and roaming charges may apply to internet use. If you are not the bill payer, obtain the bill payer's permission.

Keep your devices charged and maintain sufficient free storage during a transfer. An interrupted connection, low battery, insufficient storage, unsupported data or a third-party service failure may prevent completion. Verify the result before removing original data.
